data.description: A modular friction welding machine designed for a forge force of 77 to 1500 kN. Its documented features include VIPER Drive for simulating inertia processes, weld data export, component tracking, and an OPC UA interface for data exchange and analysis.
data.device_function: Joins components using rotary friction welding, with documented functions for preparing components, controlling and monitoring the welding process, and recording weld data.

product_family.quote: The KUKA Invictus product family provides impressive performance with friction welding machines in the medium forge-force range up to 1500 kN.

device_type.quote: The KUKA Invictus 150 friction welding machine replaces up to six friction welders

description.quote: The cost-effective, modular KUKA Invictus 150 replaces up to six friction welder models and raises common applications to a higher level of performance. It is designed for a forge force of 77 to 1500 kN, which covers a wide range of components and even replaces special machines such as the RS 120 HS or RS 300 HS. The “Viper Drive” feature even enables it to simulate inertia processes as a direct-drive machine.

device_function.quote: Friction welding is a pressure welding process. This technology can be used to join materials of the same type or of different types.

protocols_json.quote: OPC UA interface for Industry 4.0, enabling data exchange for data analysis, process optimization and cost reduction
